name: Long March 4B
location_str: Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) has flown 138 launches since its first in 2003, 7 of them this year. Its previous launch was 43 days earlier.
slot_b_text: The 50th launch of the year for China's CASC, 620th all time. That is a launch every six days. Long March 4B is on a 38-flight success streak. Worldwide, it is attempt number 249 of the year.
rocket_fact: The Kármán line, 100 km (62 miles) above Earth, is widely used as a conventional boundary of space.
